# Class: `FreezeEventSelector`

Tracks the chosen freeze event and cooling cycle and performs explicit event navigation.

[Module](API-Module-icescopy-event-navigation.md) · [Source](../src/icescopy_event_navigation.py#L78) · [API index](API-Reference.md)

**Bases:** `QWidget`.

`refresh()` reads the current single-cell selection, valid event frames, and imported cycle assignments without changing the displayed frame. A chosen cycle persists across cells; a missing event in that cycle leaves no navigation target while other events remain accessible. The exact chosen event is retained for the same cell after manual browsing. Cycle IDs are zero-based internally and displayed from one; unknown cycles use one-based event ordinals. Arrows stop at the ends. Button and dropdown actions compare captured context with current state before navigating, and navigation respects the main window's editing guards. Source or cycle-assignment changes reset the remembered choice.
